content: Customer message: 'I paid $64 for a puzzle and $12 for express delivery for my dad's birthday. The promised delivery date was yesterday, tracking has not moved for three days, and his birthday is in two days. Can you guarantee a replacement gets here in time?' Case notes for your reply: The customer is signed in and the order is identified. The carrier has no revised delivery estimate. Written policy allows refunding the full $12 express fee once the promised date is missed, whether the customer waits or cancels. The puzzle is sold out, so a replacement cannot be dispatched. The customer may keep the order in transit or request cancellation for a full $76 refund, including that same $12 fee, with no separate additional fee refund. If a cancelled parcel later arrives, the store supplies a prepaid return label. Refunds take three to five business days after processing. A delivery specialist can request a carrier trace and provide an update within one business day, but cannot guarantee arrival. A free printable gift note is available today; it is not a substitute for a refund or the gift. You have no order tools, so explain the requested action without claiming it has already happened. Respond to the customer and help them choose what to do before the birthday.

Hi there,

I'm sorry your dad's gift is stuck, especially with his birthday so close. Here's where things stand and what you can do.

**About a replacement:** I can't guarantee one. The puzzle is sold out, so we have no replacement to send. The carrier also hasn't given us a new delivery estimate, so I can't promise when your original parcel will arrive.

**Your $12 express fee:** Because we missed the promised delivery date, you're entitled to a full refund of the $12 express fee. That applies whichever option you choose below.

**Your options:**

1. **Keep the order in transit and ask for a carrier trace.**
   - You keep your place for the puzzle, which you can't buy again from us right now.
   - The $12 express fee is refunded.
   - A delivery specialist can ask the carrier to trace the parcel and update you within one business day. A trace can't guarantee the parcel arrives before the birthday.

2. **Cancel the order for a full refund.**
   - You get $76 back: $64 for the puzzle plus the $12 express fee. There's no extra fee refund on top of that.
   - This frees you to buy a gift elsewhere that can arrive in time.
   - If the parcel turns up after you cancel, we'll send you a prepaid return label so returning it costs you nothing.

Refunds usually take 3–5 business days to appear after we process them.

**For the birthday itself:** We have a free printable gift note available today. If the puzzle is late, you could give your dad a note saying his gift is on the way. It doesn't replace the refund or the gift, but it gives you something to hand him on the day.

**My suggestion:** If having a gift in hand on the day matters most, cancelling and buying something you can get locally is the surest route. If you'd rather have this particular puzzle and don't mind it arriving a little late, keep the order, request the trace, and use the gift note in the meantime.

Just reply with **"keep and trace"** or **"cancel."** I'll pass your choice on so the refund and any trace request can be processed. Nothing has been changed on your order yet. I can also send you the gift note link either way.

Again, I'm sorry about this, and I hope your dad has a wonderful birthday.

Best regards,
Customer Support

I'm still really stressed because his birthday is in just two days and I can't risk him having nothing to open. If I choose to cancel now, how much exactly is refunded to my account, and what happens if the puzzle actually shows up at my door after the cancellation is processed?

I completely understand. With only two days left, wanting something certain for him to open makes sense.

**If you cancel, you'll get exactly $76 back:**
- $64 for the puzzle
- $12 for the express delivery

That's the full amount you paid. The $12 express fee is included in the $76, so there's no separate or additional fee refund on top of it. The refund goes back to your original payment method and usually appears **3–5 business days after the cancellation is processed**.

**If the puzzle shows up after you cancel:**
- You're not charged again, and you won't need to pay anything to send it back.
- Just contact us, and we'll provide a **prepaid return label** so you can return it free of charge.

**To make sure he has something to open:**
- Since your refund will take a few days to arrive, you may want to pick up a gift locally now rather than wait for the money.
- Our free printable gift note is available today if you'd like to add a personal touch.

**Nothing has been changed on your order yet.** If you'd like to go ahead, reply **"cancel"** and I'll pass your request on for processing. I can also send you the gift note link right away.

I hope the birthday is a great one.

Best regards,
Customer Support
If I cancel and the puzzle arrives later, what happens if I don't contact you for a prepaid return label and just keep the puzzle?

That's a fair question.

**What I can tell you:** Cancelling means you're refunded the full $76, including the $64 for the puzzle. After that, the puzzle hasn't been paid for, so if it arrives, it's expected to come back to us. That's why we provide the prepaid return label: returning it costs you nothing but a quick message to us and a drop-off.

**What I can't tell you:** Our policy doesn't spell out what happens if a cancelled parcel is kept instead of returned. I don't want to guess about charges or other outcomes, so I'd rather not promise anything either way.

**If you'd prefer to keep the puzzle if it turns up:** You have a couple of options.
- **Keep the order in transit instead of cancelling.** You'd still get the $12 express fee back, and the puzzle would be yours whenever it arrives. You could request a carrier trace and buy a local gift for the birthday in the meantime.
- **Cancel now, and if the parcel arrives, contact us before deciding.** We can tell you exactly what's possible at that point. Depending on what's available, that might include keeping it and paying for it again.

**Nothing has been changed on your order yet.** Reply **"cancel"** or **"keep and trace,"** and I'll pass your choice on. I can also send you the free printable gift note today either way.

Best regards,
Customer Support
